overarchingInquiryQuestion: What does it mean to write with power and precision, and how do accomplished writers make deliberate craft decisions that serve a specific audience, purpose and form?

auditPoints.text: strengthen and extend skills and confidence as an accomplished writer across imaginative, discursive and persuasive forms
use language to convey ideas and emotions with power and precision
make deliberate craft decisions in voice, syntax, imagery and structure for a specific audience, purpose and form
draw on the study of prescribed and mentor texts as models for your own composition
respond to an unseen stimulus by developing an idea from it rather than describing it
reflect on and evaluate your own composing choices where a reflection is required
